paite: Ngai un, dangtak peuhmahte aw, tuite ah hong pai un, dangka neiloute; hong pai unla, lei unla ne un! Ahi, hong pai unla, uain leh nawitui dangka pe lou in, aman leng pe lou in lei un.
heading: Pathian Piak Lainatna
english: “Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

paite: An hiloupi a bang ding a dangka pai? Niang leh taina hilou a bang ding a na tha uh pai? Ka thuhoihtak in ngaikhia unla, thil hoih ne un, na hinna uh thil thau in nuamsa hen.
english: Why do you spend money for that which is not bread, and your labor for that which doesn’t satisfy? Listen diligently to me, and eat that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in richness.

paite: Na bil uh doh unla, ka kiang ah hong pai un; za unla, huchi in na hinna uh ahing ding; na kiang uah tangtawn thu ka khung ding, David kiang a huai hehpihna chiamte.
english: Turn your ear, and come to me. Hear, and your soul will live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.

paite: Ngai in, michih a ding in amah palai in ka sep a, michih a ding in makai leh heutu in ka sep ahi.
english: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the peoples, a leader and commander to the peoples.

paite: Ngai in, na theih ngei louh na sam ding a, nang hon thei ngei lou namte na kiang ah ahong tai ding uh, TOUPA na Pathian ziak leh Israelte Mi Siangthou ziak in; ama'n ahon pahtawi ngal a.
english: Behold, you shall call a nation that you don’t know; and a nation that didn’t know you shall run to you, because of Yahweh your God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he has glorified you.”

paite: Muh theih a a-om lai in TOUPA zong unla, anai lai in amah sam un;
english: Seek Yahweh while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.

paite: Migilou in a-omdan tawpsan henla, midiktat lou in angaihtuahnate tawpsan sam hen; TOUPA kiang ah kik nawn hen, huchi in ama'n atung ah zahngaihna asuah ding; i Pathian kiang uah kik nawn hen, ama'n angaidam mahmah ding hi.
english: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy on him, to our God, for he will freely pardon.

paite: Ka ngaihtuahte na ngaihtuahte ahi kei a, na omdante leng ka omdan ahi sam kei, TOUPA'N achi.
english: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says Yahweh.

paite: Leitung sang a vante asa zawk bang in, ka omdante na omdan sang in asangzaw hi, ka ngaihtuahte leng na ngaihtuahte uh sang in asang lai hi.
english: “For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

paite: Vuah leh vuk van a kipan azu a, huai lam ah akiktou ngei kei, lei avak zaw hi, thil apousak in adawnsak a, buhchi thehmi kiang ah buhchi apia a, nemi kiang ah nek ding ape zel hi.
english: For as the rain comes down and the snow from the sky, and doesn’t return there, but waters the earth, and makes it grow and bud, and gives seed to the sower and bread to the eater;

paite: Huchi mah bang in ka kam a kipan ka thupawt a-om ding; bangmah hih nei lou in ka kiang ah akik nawn kei ding a, ka deih bang ahihzou zaw ding a, thilhih ding a ka sawlna ah leng alohching ding.
english: so is my word that goes out of my mouth: it will not return to me void, but it will accomplish that which I please, and it will prosper in the thing I sent it to do.

paite: Nuam satak a pawt in, lungmuangtak a pikhiak a om ding na hi ngal ua; tangte leh mual neute'n na ma uah la asakhe guih ding uh, gamlak sing tengteng in leng akhut uh abeng ding uh.
english: For you shall go out with joy, and be led out with peace. The mountains and the hills will break out before you into singing; and all the trees of the fields will clap their hands.

paite: Loulingnei tang in meilah apou zaw ding a, khaulingnei tang in muising apou zaw ding; huai TOUPA minhoihna ding leh tangtawn chiamtehna hihman a om lou ding ahi ngal a.
english: Instead of the thorn the cypress tree will come up; and instead of the brier the myrtle tree will come up. It will make a name for Yahweh, for an everlasting sign that will not be cut off.”
